scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for an office building. The location is in Turin.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an office building to convert it into an autonomous senior day center (CDIA) for 18 guests in Turin with at least 360 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an office building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into an autonomous senior day center (CDIA).
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 360 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 18 people.
Ce: A well-insulated building with balanced year-round heating and cooling to protect elderly guests from heatwaves or cold spells.
I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
clarifications.Cp: I have no requirement on proximity to healthcare or medical clinics.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Offices and similar' AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
